# `network/crypto/Hpke.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/crypto/Hpke.js`

RFC 9180 base mode: DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM or AES-256-GCM. Signaling uses a fresh encapsulation for every message, so the AEAD sequence number is always zero and the base nonce is used directly. Existing callers remain on AES-128-GCM unless they opt into the exported AES-256 suite.

## Functions

### `async generateHpkeKeyPair({ cryptoImpl = globalThis.crypto } = {})`

### `async hpkeSeal(recipientPublicKeyHex, plaintext, options = {})`

### `async hpkeOpen(recipientPrivateKey, encHex, ciphertextHex, options = {})`

### `hpkeSealAes256(recipientPublicKeyHex, plaintext, options = {})`

RFC 9180 base mode using DHKEM(P-256), HKDF-SHA256, and AES-256-GCM.

### `hpkeOpenAes256(recipientPrivateKey, encHex, ciphertextHex, options = {})`

Open an AES-256-GCM RFC 9180 base-mode encapsulation.

- `HPKE_AES_256_GCM`
